posts.text: Namaste! 🙏 School khulne se pehle parents ek hi trip mein poori list khareedte hain: tees, track pants, socks, innerwear, shoes. Is baar stock time par aur sahi sizes mein ready rakhiye. Our new free guide covers timing, kids' size ratios and bundles that lift your bill:

School reopening = one of the busiest weeks of the year for kidswear. 🎒

Our new guide for shop owners covers:
• What parents buy beyond the uniform
• When to order so stock lands before the rush
• Kids' size ratios (many parents buy one size up)
• Bundles that lift your average bill
• Avoiding leftover stock after the season

Read it free at the link in bio.

#Kidswear #KidswearWholesale #BackToSchool #ClothingShop #RetailIndia #BoutiqueOwner #GarmentBazaar

For kidswear brands, school reopening is one of the clearest demand moments in the Indian retail calendar. Parents in Tier 2, 3 and 4 towns buy everyday wear, innerwear, socks and shoes in one or two trips, and they go to the shop that has the full list and the right sizes ready.

Those local retailers are often the hardest buyers for a brand to reach without a field sales team. GarmentBazaar lets brands list wholesale collections with their own MOQs and the price per piece shown up front, so retailers anywhere in India can discover and order them online. Every brand and listing is reviewed before it goes live, and joining is free.

We also publish free buying guides for those retailers. This week's covers stocking kidswear for school reopening season.

Getting ready for the next school season? Browse wholesale kidswear from reviewed brands: tees, dresses, ethnic sets and winter wear. The wholesale price per piece is shown on every listing before you sign up, MOQs are set by each brand, and it is free for retailers.
